text: The Wi-Fi in the library keeps dropping every afternoon and nobody seems to fix it.
Library internet is unusable after lunch, my video calls keep cutting out.
Wi-Fi on the second floor of the library disconnects every few minutes during study hours.
The Wi-Fi in the main block disconnects every few minutes during lectures.
Campus Wi-Fi is so slow near the labs that I cannot even submit assignments on time.
Internet goes down in the seminar hall right when we need it for presentations, it is so embarrassing.
The canteen queue at lunch is insane, I waited 25 minutes and only two counters were open.
I wait almost half an hour in the canteen queue every day because they never open enough counters at lunch.
Canteen food is always cold by the time I reach the counter and the prices keep going up.
There is never enough seating in the canteen during lunch, people are eating standing up.
The canteen runs out of rice by 1 pm, which means anyone who has a 12 to 1 lecture goes hungry.
Canteen hygiene is really bad, I found a hair in my food twice this week and nobody seems to care.
There is no hot water in the hostel bathrooms in the morning, it has been like this for two weeks.
Hot water in the girls hostel stopped working again, we are bathing with cold water in October.
The water pressure on the third floor of the boys hostel is so low that showers take forever.
Hostel water supply cuts off every morning right when everyone is getting ready for class.
The hostel common room lights have been broken for three weeks and no one from maintenance has come.
Mosquitoes in the hostel rooms are unbearable, there is no net on the windows and no one responds to complaints.
The college bus arrives twenty minutes late almost every day and we miss the first lecture.
Our college bus is always late and we end up missing the first period every single morning.
There is no bus after 6 pm so students staying for lab work have no safe way to get home.
The evening bus was cancelled again without any notice and I had to take an auto home spending 200 rupees.
The library closes at 6 pm but exam season is when we need it most, why can it not stay open until 9?
There are never enough seats in the library during exam time, I had to study on the floor.
The library air conditioning is broken and it is too hot to sit and study there in the afternoon.
Half the books on the reading list are always marked as issued and never returned, so we cannot access them.
The AC in classroom C102 has not worked for a month, it is 35 degrees outside and we cannot concentrate.
The air conditioning in the department seminar hall is broken again and every class feels like a sauna.
AC in the computer lab leaks water onto the floor near the back row, it is a safety hazard.
The AC units on the fourth floor have been off since last month with no update from administration.
There is no proper parking for two-wheelers and my bike got scratched because everything is crammed together.
The student parking area is flooded after every rain and we cannot park or walk without getting wet.
The washrooms near the ground floor labs are always dirty and the cleaners only come once a day.
There is no soap or hand wash in any of the washrooms on the second floor, it has been missing for days.
The projector in D201 keeps flickering and the faculty has complained multiple times but nothing has been fixed.
Benches in the old block classrooms are broken and uncomfortable, some of them are actually dangerous to sit on.
The campus medical room is only open until 2 pm which is useless if you feel sick during an evening lab.
The basketball court lights do not work after 5 pm so we cannot practice in the evening at all.
The only printer in the library is always jammed or out of paper right before submission deadlines.
The Wi-Fi password was changed without telling anyone and the IT desk was unreachable for two days.
